strings.name: Yvon Chouinard
strings.summary: Chouinard began with climbing and handmade hardware, promoting cleaner climbing with partners before establishing Patagonia clothing. He linked durable products, environmental giving and business, advancing organic cotton and repair. In 2022 his family transferred equity to a purpose trust and environmental organization, preserving mission governance. He continued public advocacy for wild fish in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Patagonia, combining outdoor products, environmental action and innovation in corporate ownership.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born 9 November 1938 in Lewiston, Maine, United States.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Taught himself blacksmithing and developed equipment design through climbing practice.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Outdoor products and environment
strings.highlights.h1.text: Used equipment and clothing businesses to support climbing culture, durable products and environmental action.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Ownership structure
strings.highlights.h2.text: The family transferred voting shares to a purpose trust and other shares to Holdfast Collective for environmental goals.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Iceland aquaculture comment
strings.timeline.t1.text: Submitted public comments on Iceland’s aquaculture bill and protection of wild salmon.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Ownership transfer
strings.timeline.t2.text: The family announced the transfer of Patagonia equity to Patagonia Purpose Trust and Holdfast Collective.
strings.timeline.t3.title: 1% for the Planet
strings.timeline.t3.text: Co-founded the organization with Craig Mathews to encourage environmental giving from business sales.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Organic cotton
strings.timeline.t4.text: Patagonia switched its cotton clothing to organic cotton, changing sourcing.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Patagonia brand
strings.timeline.t5.text: Established the outdoor clothing brand, extending climbing-equipment experience.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Clean-climbing equipment
strings.timeline.t6.text: With partners, promoted removable chocks to reduce damage from repeatedly driven pitons.
strings.timeline.t7.title: North America Wall
strings.timeline.t7.text: Made its first ascent with Robbins, Frost and Pratt in Yosemite.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Handmade climbing hardware
strings.timeline.t8.text: Bought forging equipment and began making and selling steel pitons.
